title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (activerecord) — review required
description: In activerecord, .wheres*([^)]*(?:+|#{) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via hash conditions.
applicability: activerecord data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
